'''Rontzken''' is a regional language associated with mountain and mining communities in [[Imperial Rhovland]] and with the [[Federation of Vinterholm]] source infobox.

The extracted source places its main speech areas in [[Bergmark]] and [[Tiefland]], where it is tied to highland settlement, mining vocabulary, metalworking, and mountain-weather terminology. This draft treats those descriptions as cultural geography rather than a fixed 1994 census.

== Linguistic Profile ==

Rontzken belongs to the [[Valderic languages]] and uses the [[Valderic script]] with additional cluster-marking conventions. The source emphasizes dense consonant clusters, technical mining vocabulary, and a grammatical distinction between above-ground, below-ground, and surface-level action.

The language's native name, ''Rontzken Bergsprech'', links it to mountains, stone, and practical knowledge. Current drafts do not harden the extracted alphabet table because the dump contains corrupted characters.

== Cultural Role ==

Rontzken is associated with the [[Rontzken Mountain Chronicles]], a highland oral and literary tradition preserving mining history, mountain conflict memory, and relations between regional communities and wider Rhovlandian federal authority.

The source names later academic and technical institutions, but those references are post-1994 citations or undated institutional context. They should not be treated as proof of pre-1994 founding dates.
